scope: Original52frontiers preserved as starting evidence, not a live progress claim.

entries.question_title: The precise RustBelt → MiniRust bridge
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Original value-cell λRust, concrete Radium and MiniRust preserve different operational distinctions. Reusable Iris/lifetime infrastructure still requires a new representation/alias relation and a safety/fundamental theorem; finite abstraction failures demonstrate lost information.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No full allocation/split/interior-mutability library proof port or MiniRust safe-client fundamental theorem.

entries.question_title: MiniRust, the Rust Reference and an end-to-end executable specification
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: A five-case Reference-linked corpus separates authority/policy from core behavior for raw places, invalid referents, zero-size operations, metadata and unions. The executable-spec plan is a direction, not current authority over all Rust.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No complete authoritative surface specification; disputed validity policy is not settled by interpreter output.

entries.question_title: Specr semantics, elaboration and formal backends
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Exact fence extraction, transform order, name-resolution limitations, effect wrappers and formal-backend artifact status are inspected. Real pinned transpilation/build is reproduced; successful generated Rust checking is distinct from import correctness.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No verified formal Specr backend/import theorem; inaccessible Specr2 work remains unknown.

entries.question_title: Angelic and demonic nondeterminism, UB and executability
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Demonic safety, empty behavior, angelic witness/continuation and failed sampling are distinguished. Checked finite quantifier/certificate controls reject omitted bad branches and scope swaps; handler constructors expose additional choice-domain conditions.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No full predictive mixed-choice game semantics or actual exposed-predict execution.

entries.question_title: Rust → MIR → MiniRust source-safety correspondence
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Effective MIR flags, retags, Copy/Move loads, cleanup-edge loss, unsupported branches and compiler-supplied layouts identify concrete source-safety obligations. An erasure countermodel distinguishes safe-source refinement from safety reflection.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: Actual minimize paired-source/intermediate-pass corpus and all constants remain unexecuted; P127 remains open.

entries.question_title: Mechanized representation laws for zerocopy contracts
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Mechanized owned codec/copy laws retain initialization/provenance/validity hypotheses. Actual core execution refutes generic enum roundtrip under present WF alone: tagger/discriminator coherence is required.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No universal scalar/array/enum/union law over full MiniRust or physical-access interpretation; P131 remains open.

entries.question_title: Typed copies, byte copies and observations of storage
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Source rules and actual padding/provenance tests distinguish typed copies, integer rewrites and union chunk preservation. Snapshot-copy controls expose overlap errors; actual short wide-pointer chunk loses metadata.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No arbitrary typed-to-byte-copy refinement, compiler-produced union counterexample or complete storage-observation theorem.

entries.question_title: Strict provenance, exposed provenance and aliasing jointly
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Address, provenance, exposure and alias permission are separate inputs. Finite tag/address and quantifier witnesses explain why an exposed-provenance choice must retain a permitted continuation and cannot invent authority.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: Wildcard exactness, all deallocation/reuse paths and a full provenance/alias compatibility theorem remain unproved.

entries.question_title: Target parameters, numeric semantics and portable claims
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Target parameters and bounded integer semantics are inventoried; mathematical32/64 little/big-endian controls are distinguished from real ARM64/wasm execution.32 numeric/layout cases pass on each real target; FP rules are explicitly outside MiniRust's type fragment.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No big-endian Rust run, full FP MiniRust extension or all-target numeric/layout theorem.

entries.question_title: Dynamic layout, DSTs, vtables and validity
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Metadata, dynamic layout, referent validity and retag masks are separate. Oversized/ZST/wrong-trait controls, niche lowering and the actual union-metadata consequence expose concrete supplied invariants.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No complete recursive-DST/niche/mask invariant or compiler-layout/vtable extraction theorem.

entries.question_title: Correspondence among the Tree Borrows calculus, MiniRust and Miri
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Owned transcriptions of pinned per-location MiniRust/Miri permission presentations agree on81915 bounded traces after normalization. Retag, protector release, masks, wildcard and race hooks are compared operation by operation with explicit differences.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No unbounded tree/memory simulation or full upstream-interpreter equivalence.

entries.question_title: An Iris program logic for byte- and alias-sensitive MiniRust memory
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: The λTB thesis's simplified Iris resources/adequacy and lateral separation are assessed against byte/full-protector MiniRust obligations; handler adequacy shows where coupled state invariants belong.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: Exact inaccessible λTB source closure and a full byte/alias MiniRust lifetime logic are not established; split/recombine, recursive-reborrow and callback proof ports remain unperformed.

entries.question_title: Protectors, `UnsafeCell` and field-sensitive invariants
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Field masks, freeze/unpin/protector settings, exit effects and allowed retained Cell aliases constrain resource contracts. Computed masks and safe callback/returned-view controls distinguish premature recovery from legal sharing.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No Iris protector/callback theorem, arbitrary nested masks or full exceptional permission restoration proof.

entries.question_title: Composing byte-level race detection with alias-sensitive memory
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Current race access lists, previous-step/all-schedules distinction, implicit alias-event hooks and access widths are inspected.6400 range pairs expose198 empty-range formula disagreements without claiming a universal race bug.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No alias-sensitive race completeness/commutation or machine adequacy theorem.

entries.question_title: Extending toward relaxed memory
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: ORC11/Iris view-sensitive ownership and adequacy scope are compared with MiniRust SC atomicity; message-passing/view controls show the synchronization premise. Named hardware/mapping research separately constrains a future extension.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No byte/alias relaxed-memory logic, native reclamation proof or automatic transfer of C11 mapping theorems to Rust.

entries.question_title: Unwinding, drop elaboration and resource restoration
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Actual core unwind/end-call operations and the concrete Drop importer omission are compared with safe cleanup/MIR traces. Thesis scalar proof and unfinished tuple extension are kept distinct; platform unwinding is a separate interface.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No complete source drop/unwind reflection, double-panic/runtime fidelity or protected-resource restoration theorem.

entries.question_title: Intrinsics, allocation and standard-library/environment contracts
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Actual intrinsic/allocation inventory and current read/write-unaligned, copy and realloc source routes are inspected. Failure/zero-size/capability and overlap controls retain implementation/environment premises.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No actual minimize of every library route, physical OOM/foreign callback or verified allocator/runtime contract.

entries.question_title: Linking functional safe-code proofs with spatial unsafe-code proofs
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Functional parser/view/callback examples and checked abstraction counterexamples identify the spatial facts a value contract may forget. Aeneas/Charon, Radium and other corpus results are compared specifically at that interface.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No automatic transport of an existing functional or RustBelt proof to a full MiniRust unsafe API theorem.

entries.question_title: Modular semantics and reusable proof components
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Actual ITree/Iris handler, translation and operational adequacy interfaces are inspected. A checked finite-trace joint byte/permission handler agrees with a direct model; omitting a read's alias effect is refuted.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No MiniRust handler instantiation, full concurrent composition or fresh Rocq artifact replay.

entries.question_title: Disagreement-driven validation and evidence classification
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Real pinned generation/core execution,23 upstream tests and8 owned core cases are retained with compiler-incompatibility/tool-availability/IllFormed/Ub/MachineStop classes. Independent package-only replay reproduces all8 cases.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No actual Miri differential run, universal allocation-choice safety or minimize/source correspondence.

entries.question_title: Static semantics, elaboration and the full Rust feature boundary
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Actual a-mir-formality checking/normalization/codegen and trusted-body/FnDef boundaries are examined. Configured method, GAT/generic, macro, pattern/temporary, callback and manual Future controls expose elaboration/owner obligations.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No execution or adequacy of formality itself, complete surface desugaring, generated async or source-item census.

entries.question_title: Open libraries, unsafe traits and contextual API soundness
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Safe-client/library/unsafe-trait quantifiers are explicit. Wrong-instance, weakened Boolean law/domain, Vec-initialization and callback/return-resource controls show why implementation premises and public domains must be independent.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No full Vec/zerocopy/contextual soundness theorem, arbitrary foreign/reentrant clients or proof port.

entries.question_title: MiniRust memory at an ABI or assembly boundary
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Concrete bytes, entry/return placements and logical allocation/borrow resources are related as separate obligations. Same-value/dead-resource and final-frame/trace witnesses refute byte-only composition; actual leaf frames provide one small operational endpoint.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No complete MiniRust↔Kraken ABI/resource/context relation or pointer-return proof.

entries.question_title: Adoption alternatives, internal TCB and shared benchmark decisions
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Five adoption routes are compared by exact available artifacts, missing arrows, internal trust and measured versus unmeasured costs. Common byte/alias/control workloads and rejection controls define a conditional evaluation plan.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No architecture selected or matched full-verifier performance ranking; R095/P127/P131 stay separate.

entries.question_title: Kraken capability, semantic coverage and theorem closure
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Both architecture states, syntax, access interpretation, selected proof statements and closures are inventoried. Closed, admitted and native-verifier-axiom examples are distinguished; fresh whole-state leaf results exercise actual models.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No ISA-wide coverage/fidelity theorem or proof on the requested Kraken nightly.

entries.question_title: Assembly source → checked AST fidelity
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Actual X64 direct/file parsing and directive erasure are executed; data/alignment changes can disappear from the AST. Selected AArch64 instruction parses are retained separately from native output.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No general macro/preprocessor/printer fidelity or complete arbitrary-assembly importer.

entries.question_title: AST, encoding, decoding and executable layout certificates
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Externally supplied layout, zero sizes, duplicate/missing labels and address wrap are probed. Tiny manufactured importer and real MachO/ELF binding controls separate bytes, decoded claim, sizes and symbol identity.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No universal Kraken AST/decoder/layout theorem or general relocation-aware loader.

entries.question_title: Kraken instructions versus authoritative/reference ISA semantics
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Seven actual AArch64 forms agree with an independent arithmetic/byte oracle and nativeO0/O3 on1290 cases includingNZCV;8 wrong-rule discriminators and full concrete model frame checks pass.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No universal ISA simulation, independent formal ASL/Sail execution, X64/fault/SIMD correspondence or all overlap ASTs.

entries.question_title: Complete access traces, permission checks and frame preservation
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Default All ignores authority; stricter interpretation and actual leaf iff require complete RET read/execute ranges. Vector request-width mismatch and final-frame countermodels distinguish map membership, access trace and logical authority.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No generic producer trace adequacy, full vector repair or Rust/page permission relation.

entries.question_title: Rust values, validity and register/byte representations
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Representation validity, initialization, padding, niches and discriminants are separate from ABI placement, as the codec/core/primitive controls demonstrate. Rust type/layout, FnAbi passing/attributes, platform conventions and inline/naked entry forms are separated. Actual signatures and four-target C witnesses expose hidden results, split values and platform register differences.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No verified ABI exporter/classifier or compiler/source-to-machine theorem.

entries.question_title: Rust allocation, provenance and borrows versus machine addresses
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Allocation liveness, provenance, aliasing, initialization and logical resources cannot be reconstructed from equal numeric bytes. Checked negative states and actual map-cell/footprint proofs identify the relation needed for Rust continuation safety.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No complete live-region/alias resource interpretation or pointer-returning assembly theorem.

entries.question_title: Inline operands, register allocation and overlap
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: A checked owned allocation/frame theorem and early-overwrite counterexample distinguish universal template correctness from a fixed emitted assignment. Actual generated inline blocks include documented legal overlap.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No complete rustc allocation theorem or exhaustive target register/subregister contract formalization.

entries.question_title: Proving compiler-facing inline effect options
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Normative effect promises become distinct access/determinism/flags/stack/control obligations. False nomem/preserves_flags specimens compile only; trace/frame and permission controls demonstrate missing guarantees.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No production checker for every option, implicit state or synchronizing assembly block.

entries.question_title: Inline stack, exits and surrounding continuations
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Compiler-managed continuations, scratch stack and exits differ from function-call ABIs. Normative label/nonreturn/unwind/motion rules and checked actual return frames state necessary continuation obligations.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No general inline-label/context-switch/duplication theorem or all proposed wrong-exit native tests.

entries.question_title: Whole-function contracts for named platform ABIs
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Named platform conventions, stack/return witnesses and full modeled frames are studied. Actual X64 hidden-clobber/wrong-return/short-stack negatives and ARM64 whole-state leaf proofs distinguish call/ret semantics from ABI conformance.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No all-platform vector/vararg/shadow-space classification or formal complete ABI relation.

entries.question_title: Native Rust ABI, `FnAbi` witnesses and wrapper alternatives
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Native Rust instability and naked restrictions motivate exact FnAbi/configuration/instance witnesses or C wrappers. Actual pair/triple/slice/unit signatures and wrong-instance controls expose omitted hidden facts.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No independently checked native-Rust FnAbi exporter or universal ABI stability claim.

entries.question_title: Verified callees, callbacks, panic and unwinding
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Rust ordinary-inline unwind restrictions, permitted whole-function ABI exits, callbacks/reentrancy and concrete platform unwind metadata are examined separately. Cleanup traces and metadata/resource controls retain all-exit obligations.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No complete verified callee/callback chain, real platform unwinder proof or arbitrary forced-unwind/nonlocal-jump support.

entries.question_title: What “behaviorally identical to pure Rust” must mean
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: A common exact wrapping specification yields equality only under a shared domain/observation mapping. Checked loose-spec, overflow-policy and resource counterexamples supplement actual arithmetic comparisons; refinement directions are explicit.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No complete bidirectional Rust/machine contextual equivalence, divergence or source-safety proof.

entries.question_title: Linking an assembly certificate into Anneal's Rust semantics
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: DimSum and semantic-type approaches identify entry, prefix safety, execution correspondence and context closure. A generic checked composition theorem exposes its hypotheses rather than instantiating them invisibly.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No ready MiniRust/Kraken mixed-language semantics, full callback relation or arbitrary safe-context theorem.

entries.question_title: Object files, linking, loading and deployed-code identity
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Actual final MachO symbol ranges and pinned ELF literal bytes are bound; one-byte/wrong-symbol/function/target/truncation and actual ADD→SUB stale-claim controls reject mismatches. Linker/LTO/relocation/dispatch mechanisms are explicitly analyzed.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No verified general decoder/loader, relocation-parametric proof, dispatch-branch or live-patching deployment theorem.

entries.question_title: Kraken fragment/WP/frame infrastructure and upstream evolution
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Baseline eventuality/separation mechanisms and live PR-specific scopes are distinguished. Fixed host identity/entry, two actual step1 composition and exact permission iff are checked for a concrete embedding.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No arbitrary-host/escape/overlap/loop/relocation proof or assumed adoption of open PR heads.

entries.question_title: Sail and generated ISA definitions, especially Lean
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Actual Sail Lean rewrite/support/configuration interfaces are inspected, including FakeReal selection and effects. Direct generated-model versus Kraken/reference refinement routes have separate trust obligations.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No generated ISA import/build or selected Sail proof; no assumption that generated syntax proves backend/hardware correctness.

entries.question_title: Isla/Islaris and Iris reasoning over realistic machine code
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Islaris trace adequacy, operational access branches and path coverage are inspected. Published RISC-V optional validation is separated from admitted Arm experimental bridge and trusted basic Isla/SMT path.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No fresh trace/ISA validation or shared upstream proof port; feasible-path completeness remains a required theorem.

entries.question_title: Jasmin and verified compilation from an assembly-oriented language
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Jasmin's actual formal assembly relation, pre/post/context premises and proved/validated/trusted passes are examined. Controlled source generation closes a different arrow from importing arbitrary assembly.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No fresh common-program Jasmin port, all-pass closure or final-byte/Rust caller theorem.

entries.question_title: Vale, F*/Dafny and verified cryptographic assembly
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Vale procedure/state/specification and backend boundaries are inspected precisely; the selected Dafny64 arithmetic updater rejects heap/stack while MOV uses another supported updater.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No fresh Vale/Dafny/F* proof, universal backend support or arbitrary Rust inline contract.

entries.question_title: HOL Light/s2n-bignum: actual bytes, subroutine contracts and access safety
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Selected s2n literal/core/subroutine/Windows statements and frame/access/security distinctions are examined. Actual assembled ELF symbol185 bytes equals the complete proof literal; three identity mutants reject.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No fresh HOL proof/axiom replay, selected safety theorem or final downstream caller/deployment proof.

entries.question_title: Other machine-code foundations and lifting/validation techniques
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: ACL2 decode/views, K rewrite/co-simulation, Bedrock2 phase/call, concrete RISC-V environment, CompCert full-range access and prior HOL lifting/hardware mechanisms are selected for concrete missing arrows.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No full cross-prover ports or rankings; original decoder/ISA/Rust-resource and environment assumptions remain explicit.

entries.question_title: Internal TCB and proof-producing assembly adapters
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Kernel axioms, native reduction, semantic definitions, source/byte import, ABI/resources and deployed identity form separate trust classes. Checked proofs and independent mutant families show what an exact consumer must bind.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No theorem that a clean axiom list verifies the kernel, semantic model, producer coverage or every malicious input.

entries.question_title: Atomics, fences and Rust/hardware weak-memory compatibility
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Named language/hardware models, actual selected compiler atomic/fence mappings, Rust access/mixed-width rules and compiler-facing asm effects are compared; finite litmus evidence remains separately labeled.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No full Rust/LLVM/hardware mapping proof, actual herd invocation or concurrent assembly wrapper verification.

entries.question_title: Constant-time and other security properties beyond functional equivalence
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Two-run observation models, s2n security analysis and selected Jasmin/Vale comparative contract/code-generation scopes distinguish functional equality, access safety and architectural constant-time. Checked same-result/address-leak witnesses and vendor timing limits preserve the security domain.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No physical side-channel/speculation/fault-injection proof or constant-time claim for the native pilot.

entries.question_title: Platform and privileged extensions: explicit scope and environment contracts
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: Interrupt/device/TLS/VM/control-flow/security extensions are conditional environment obligations. Actual Kraken nonmemory effect and owned device response, concrete MinimalMMIO restrictions and platform unwind rules make omissions consequential.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No privileged/device/hardware environment implementation theorem, full interruption/reentry or Rust ownership transfer.

entries.question_title: Shared pilot corpus, costs and conditional architecture decision
entries.research_result: bounded investigation with explicit evidence and remaining scope
entries.answered_scope: A shared evidence matrix aligns wrapping arithmetic/carry/REV, bounded bytes, real zerocopy target cases, frames/accesses and actual byte controls. Generation/checking/build/binding costs and controlled source/configuration invalidation are separated.
entries.unperformed_or_unestablished: No all-case multiply/copy/pointer/helper/SIMD proof suite or matched whole-system proof-generation/repair benchmark across every backend.
